runs.query: Find the latest official announcements about Python releases in 2026.

rows.title: asyncio homepage
rows.snippet: Deprecated backport of asyncio; use the stdlib package instead # asyncio (obsolete backport) This package once provided a backport of the `asyncio` module for Python versions prior to 3.4. The `asyncio` module has shipped with the Python standard library since Python 3.4 and this separate distribution is no longer needed. **Do not install this package.** Use the implementation that comes with Python instead: https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio.html This release contains no code and exists only to prevent accidental installation of outdated backports.
